assistants.title: Voice assistants
assistants.intro: Log and ask by voice, for example: “Alexa, tell Lotties baby the baby fell asleep”. Link your Lotties account in the Alexa app first.
assistants.hintOne: You log for one baby, so voice commands use {{name}}.
assistants.hintSeveral: You log for more than one baby: choose the one voice commands log and answer for.
assistants.saveFailed: This baby can't be used for voice commands. Choose a baby you log for.
assistants.loadFailed: Couldn't load the voice assistant settings.
assistants.privacy: Amazon processes what you say to Alexa. Lotties receives only the command and its values, and sends back the answer Alexa speaks, which can include your baby's name and recent entries.
assistants.privacyLink: How voice commands use your data (privacy policy)
